notes.title: Omega Mouse Zero Soundtrack now Available!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2949190/Omega_Mouse_Zero_Soundtrack/

10 songs that range from rock and suspense to calm melody, taking the listener on an emotional rollercoaster of hype and wonder. Listen the sounds of the Omega-Verse. From the melodies of the Mystic caves, to the epic orchestra of the dark sorcerer Shadow Cat.
